intent: Define a first scaffold for a metric on admissibility_window_space so neighborhood overlap, boundary stability, and coupling strength can be quantified.

entry.overlap_behavior: d_Phi(A_i, A_j) = 0 iff the windows are identical; decreases as volume of A_i ∩ A_j increases relative to union.
claim_limits: not yet a full metric proof
exact functional form (e.g., Jaccard-style) remains implementation-dependent

rules.name: coupling_strength_rule_v1
rules.statement: The strength of coupling between processes i and j is inversely proportional to the window distance d_Phi(A_i, A_j).

rules.name: boundary_stability_rule_v1
rules.statement: A CSI boundary is stable if the window distance d_Phi to any non-member process remains above a declared exclusion threshold tau_A.

rules.name: no_full_window_metric_claim_without_proof_v1
rules.statement: d_Phi must not be described as a full metric until identity, symmetry, and triangle inequality are proven for window sets.

rules.name: no_coupling_strength_without_d_Phi_v1
rules.statement: Quantitative claims about coupling strength must cite d_Phi or an equivalent window-distance metric.

closure_progress: admissibility_window distance scaffold registered as PHI_METRIC_V1
still_blocking: mapping to specific graph-engine topology rules
simulation validation of csi boundary transitions
